briefdescription.para: This file defines the SparseSet class derived from the version described in Briggs, Torczon, "An efficient representation for sparse sets", ACM Letters on Programming Languages and Systems, Volume 2 Issue 1-4, March-Dec.

detaileddescription.para: A sparse set holds a small number of objects identified by integer keys from a moderately sized universe. The sparse set uses more memory than other containers in order to provide faster operations.
